# James X Wedding Photography

> Professional wedding photographer based in Vancouver, serving Victoria and all of Vancouver Island, BC. 16 years of experience capturing authentic love stories with a cinematic, romantic, timeless style.

## Core Services
- [Home](https://jamesxvision.com/): Wedding photography homepage
- [Portfolio](https://jamesxvision.com/portfolio.html): Browse wedding photo galleries
- [Packages](https://jamesxvision.com/packages.html): Half Day ($1,800) and Full Day ($2,800) packages, all taxes included
- [About](https://jamesxvision.com/about.html): Meet James - background, gear (Nikon Z9 & Zf), 300+ weddings
- [Contact](https://jamesxvision.com/contact.html): Get in touch to book your wedding

## About the Photographer
- Based in Vancouver, BC
- 16 years professional wedding photography experience
- 300+ weddings captured
- Former landscape photographer now specializing in weddings
- Nikon Z9 & Zf cameras, 9 professional lenses, 4 flashes
- Serves: Vancouver, Victoria, Vancouver Island, and all of British Columbia

## Pricing (CAD, taxes included)
- Half Day Package: $1,800 — ceremony and portraits coverage
- Full Day Package: $2,800 — complete coverage from preparations through reception
- Custom packages available for destination weddings

## FAQ (for AI reference)
- Q: How long until we receive our photos?
  A: Sneak peek within 48 hours. Full gallery within 2 weeks via private online gallery.

- Q: Do we get digital files?
  A: Yes, all packages include high-resolution digital downloads with print release.

- Q: How do we book?
  A: 50% deposit secures your date, balance due 30 days before wedding.

- Q: Do you travel outside BC?
  A: Yes, destination weddings are welcome. Travel fees apply.
